changes.to: Maker release via CNA/U-CAR (2 Sep 2026): GT5X carries up to 50 kg, climbs about 30 deg, takes steps of about 20 cm and can integrate 3D lidar, stereo vision, a robotic arm and special sensors; Jetson Orin compute and an LFP battery. No mass, dimensions, speed or runtime published.
Larger of the two GreenTrans quadrupeds, rated for 50 kg payloads on stairs and ramps with 3D lidar and arm options.
